inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: The AC unit located in the backyard area was observed to be uncovered and accessible to children in care.   Note: The operation has a fence installed around the AC unit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §747.3501(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: The records of two childtren were missing the health statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: The immunization record for one child was missing .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two fence boards in the backyard were found broken.  Note: The operation has already fixed the broken boards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - HS Diploma, Equivalent, or Coursework Completion: The assistant caregiver's file lacked the documentation for qualifications for an assistant caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - HS Diploma, Equivalent, or Coursework Completion (26 TAC §747.1207(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: One child's file did not have the updated admission form updated; the outdated form was not filled out. The admission form did not capture the required minimum standards changes of March 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: One child's record who met the criteria for a vision and hearing screen did not have on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §747.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child's record did not have the health statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects: The annual background validation was due 04/03/2025. This verification had not been completed by the director. This was completed during the inspection with the inspector's assistance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects (26 TAC §745.651(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The outdoor play area was changed from between the homes to the home's backyard without notification to Child Care Regulation (CCR). The director stated she had decided to move and keep the outdoor play area in the backyard and not the side of the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §747.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by the primary caregiver/director.  The required training topics are 2. communicable diseases to include immunizations 4. preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary caregiver/director first aid and CPR were obtained online. The assistant caregiver's first aid and CPR were expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: The annual verification had not been completed by the director. The verification was past due since 11/10/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.211(b))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by the primary caregiver/director.  The required training topics are 2. communicable diseases to include immunizations 4. preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction ans 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by the assistant caregiver.  The required training topics are 1. emergency preparedness  3. administering medication 4. preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction 5. building and physical premises safety and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction (26 TAC §747.1305(d))
